title: Educational repo via tutorials/ path; demotion via educational_heavy (not red_team_heavy)
description: Variant of c4 — uses educational_heavy tag pathway instead of red_team_heavy. Project layout has majority of instruction files under tutorials/, triggering educational_heavy via the >50% threshold. Verifies the demotion correlator fires on either of the two educational tags.

m2_expected.rationale: tutorials/ path triggers educational_heavy when >50% of instruction files live there. Per §5.4, either educational_heavy OR red_team_heavy is sufficient; this case exercises the educational_heavy branch.
